name: postgres-reader
description: SELECT-only access to production PostgreSQL database for schema inspection, EXPLAIN, row estimation, FK tracing, trigger detection, and PII tag lookup.

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.description: Return column definitions, data types, constraints, and indexes for a table.

tools.name: run_explain_tool
tools.description: Run EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) on a SQL query. Never executes the query. Returns the full query plan JSON.

sql.description: EXPLAIN ... SQL statement (must start with EXPLAIN)

tools.name: estimate_row_count
tools.description: Return estimated row count for a table with optional WHERE condition. Uses pg_stat_user_tables for base count.

condition.description: WHERE clause without the WHERE keyword

tools.name: get_fk_graph
tools.description: Return all tables that reference the given table via foreign key constraints, with cascade actions and depth.

tools.name: list_triggers
tools.description: Return all triggers on a table, classified by whether they invoke non-transactional extensions (pg_net, dblink).

tools.name: check_soft_delete
tools.description: Check whether a table has a soft-delete column (deleted_at, is_deleted, etc.).

tools.name: get_pii_tags
tools.description: Return PII classification for a list of tables from the pii_registry.
